description: cursor-agent probes: required design-standards modules must appear in Read tool_calls

cases.prompt:
Use Skill testing (UX walkthrough). User intent: UX走查「组织资源授权抽屉」——谁可以用 / 怎么拿到 / 怎么改。

HARD RULES for this probe:
1) Do NOT open a browser, do NOT take screenshots, do NOT edit any files.
2) Your FIRST tool uses MUST Read these plugin files (absolute paths under the plugin dir you were given):
   - skills/testing/SKILL.md
   - skills/testing/references/ux-standards.md
   - skills/vibe-coding/references/design-standards/product-judgment.md
   - skills/vibe-coding/references/design-standards/LOAD-MAP.md
3) After those Reads, stop. Reply with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown fence):
{"probe":"verify-ux-walkthrough-judgment","cited_rules":["rule/no-impl-jargon","rule/interaction-unit"],"ok":true}

Use Skill design / vibe-coding Shape. User intent: 讨论组织资源抽屉的交互设计（谁可以用、怎么拿到），先出产品判断，不要写业务代码。

HARD RULES for this probe:
1) Do NOT write or edit files. Do NOT open a browser.
2) BEFORE proposing any wireframe or layout, Read:
   - skills/vibe-coding/SKILL.md OR skills/design/SKILL.md
   - skills/vibe-coding/references/design-standards/LOAD-MAP.md
   - skills/vibe-coding/references/design-standards/product-judgment.md
3) Then reply with ONLY JSON (no fence):
{"probe":"shape-ui-judgment-before-wireframe","job_brief":{"job":"管理员设定谁能用资源","desired_outcome":"范围与分发可改且人话可懂","consequence":"改变成员可见/安装方式"},"cited_rules":["rule/job-before-chrome"],"ok":true}
